subject: gk
question: Which of the following refers to the net money value of all the final goods and services produced by the normal residents of a country, during a period of one year?

options.text: Net National Product at market price
Net National Product at factor cost
Gross National Product at market price
Gross National Product at factor cost

solution: The correct answer is **__Net National Product at factor cost__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Net National Product at factor cost refers to the net money value of all the final goods and services produced by the normal residents of a country, during a period of one year. • The Net National Product at Factor Cost, also known as **national income**. • When calculated at factor cost, the NNP includes the sum of wages, rents, interests, and profits distributed in an economy but excludes indirect taxes while including subsidies. • Thus, it reflects the income earned through the productive activities of the country's normal residents. • **Factor Cost + Indirect Tax - Subsidy = Market Price** • **NNP = GNP – Depreciation**
